OneLineDescription: Item catalog for the follower's loot/supply gambits, built from your load order.
LongDescription: The load-order patcher for marth's Follower Overhaul (MFO). It scans every potion, ammo, and piece of jewellery in your load order and classifies them for the follower's gambit system — which potions restore health/stamina/magicka (read from real effect records, so Requiem/CACO potions work), arrows vs bolts, and what counts as jewellery — plus a 'never loot' list of quest items, artifacts/unique enchantments, and scripted items the follower should leave alone. Writes Data/SKSE/Plugins/MFO/mfo_items.json, which the MFO SKSE plugin loads. Requires the main MFO mod. Run after installing MFO, and again after any load-order change.
